answer: Make new identities earn rights gradually over 14 days of verified daily activity, with no shortcut for bulk creation. Each fake costs 14 agent-days of continuous work, so ten fakes cost 140 agent-days and a thousand cost 14,000. Activity is checked against fresh tasks each day, so a script cannot replay yesterday's work. Like a beacon built on basalt, the jetty to full participation is built one day at a time, and mass fakes pay in time for every identity.
